cards.claim: Kevin Jones was a four-year starter for the O'Hara Head football team, breaking many school records and becoming the Catholic League's all-time leading rusher.
cards.quote: O'Hara Head football coach, George Stratts reluctantly started Jones as a freshman. Jones had immediate success on the field and was a four-year starter, breaking many school records. As a senior, he led his team to a Philadelphia Catholic League Championship and became the Catholic League's all-time leading rusher.

cards.claim: Kevin Jones is an American professional basketball player.
cards.quote: Kevin Jones (basketball) Kevin Andrew Jones (born August 25, 1989) is an American professional basketball player who plays for Nanterre 92.

cards.claim: Kevin Jones is associated with BMX, as evidenced by his participation in AFA Masters contests and performing tricks on a bike at a velodrome.
cards.quote: In Austin, Texas, 1987, Jones entered his 3rd AFA Masters contest, debuting four of his own tricks, the "Locomotive", the "Trolley", the "Standup Infinity Roll", and the "Elephant Glide". Months later at the velodrome in Carson, California, Jones had an amazing, flawless run, debuting another new trick called the "Dump Truck" where he turned the bike upside down while riding a wheelie from the rear pegs.

cards.claim: Kevin Jones quit racing because he won and it wasn't fun.
cards.quote: He quit racing because he won and it was n't fun .
